beam.title: Life Beam
beam.description: A focused white beam of pure life energy that heals allies and restores vitality to entities it touches.

phasing.title: Phasing
phasing.description: A white power ring lets the wielder phase through some solid objects, though which ones are immune may depend on the user’s strength and the object’s density.

beamdummy.title: Life Beam
beamdummy.description: A focused white beam of pure life energy that heals allies and restores vitality to entities it touches.

spectrumchange.title: Emotional Spectrum Dominance
spectrumchange.description: Concentrate and Access other spectrums and use their abilities

green.title: Willpower
green.description: Access the Green Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

willpowershield.title: Will Power Shield
willpowershield.description: You must have a empty Offhand to use this ability.
first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with final_lanterns:shield{CustomTag:green}

blue.title: Hope
blue.description: Access the Blue Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

pink.title: Love
pink.description: Access the Pink Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

inflict_fear.title: Inflict Fear
commands: execute as @s[distance=..5,palladium.power=final_lanterns:yellowlantern] run energybar value subtract @p final_lanterns:yellowlantern fear 1

yellow.title: Fear
yellow.description: Access the Yellow Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

red.title: Rage
red.description: Access the Red Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

swap_hand.title: That's Mine!
swap_hand.description: Allows you to Steal any item in the aposing Players main hand at the cost of the Ability and all of your Energy

orange.title: Greed
orange.description: Access the Orange Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

purple.title: Compassion
purple.description: Access the Indigo Lanterns Emotional Spectrum to use their abilities

ringconstruction.title: Ring Construction
ringconstruction.description: This final ability allows you to create a duplicate of your current ring at the cost of all your life force. Once used, the ability becomes locked. Note: You must have Life Max lvl 3 and Crouching

first_tick_commands: execute as @s anchored eyes positioned ^ ^ ^3 run function final_lanterns:whitelanternconstruction

waypointset.title: Wormhole Waypoint A
first_tick_commands: execute as @s store result score @s Foi1y.Waypoint.A.X run data get entity @s Pos[0]
execute as @s store result score @s Foi1y.Waypoint.A.Y run data get entity @s Pos[1]
execute as @s store result score @s Foi1y.Waypoint.A.Z run data get entity @s Pos[2]

waypointsetb.title: Wormhole Waypoint B
waypointsetb.description: Crouch and use the Waypoint Keybind to set a Wormhole Waypoint
first_tick_commands: execute as @s store result score @s Foi1y.Waypoint.B.X run data get entity @s Pos[0]
execute as @s store result score @s Foi1y.Waypoint.B.Y run data get entity @s Pos[1]
execute as @s store result score @s Foi1y.Waypoint.B.Z run data get entity @s Pos[2]

openportalprimary.title: Open Portal
first_tick_commands: execute at @s run particle minecraft:dust 0.6 0 1 1 ~0 ~1 ~0 0.5 0.5 0.5 1 400 force
execute at @s run particle minecraft:falling_obsidian_tear ~0 ~1 ~0 0.2 0.3 0.20 0.1 20 force

telekinesis.title: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Telekinesis with a White Lantern Ring allows the wielder to move, restrain, or manipulate objects and beings using pure life energy, guided by their life power.
